text: Payment update for apmix.ai We're removing fungies.io from the site. Stripe has placed restrictions on Fungies' account, and from December 1 they won't be able to process payments or renewals anymore. So from now on all subscriptions go through creem.io only. If you subscribed through Fungies, your subscription will be cancelled and won't renew. To keep your plan, subscribe again from apmix.ai/dashboard/billing . Your account and API keys stay the same. We're also sending an email to everyone affected. Questions: support@apmix.ai

apmix Business is open for companies and resellers who want to resell AI or build on it at volume. One API key gets you 18 models: Grok, Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax, MiMo, Hunyuan and more. Usage is billed in weighted tokens: each model draws from your balance at its own multiplier, and your tier sets the price of that balance. Business: $0.06 per 1M weighted tokens, 600 requests/min per key, for spend from $100 a month Scale: $0.05 per 1M weighted tokens, 3,000 requests/min per key, for spend from $1,000 a month Enterprise: custom price and limits, from $5,000 a month For example, on Business, GLM-5.3 costs $0.06 per 1M tokens, DeepSeek V4 Flash costs $0.018 and MiMo V2.6 Flash costs $0.006. The balance is prepaid and doesn’t expire. Applications are reviewed by hand, usually within 2 business days. Apply here: https://business.apmix.ai/
